name: Markdown Editor
description: Write Markdown with live preview, outline and word count, and export to HTML
help: Supports GitHub Flavored Markdown: tables, task lists, footnotes, strikethrough and alerts such as > [!NOTE].
The preview is rendered in Rust. Raw HTML is shown as text and unsafe links are removed, so documents from anywhere are safe to open.
Your draft is saved automatically and restored the next time you open the tool.
Shortcuts: ⌘/Ctrl+S save, ⌘/Ctrl+B bold, ⌘/Ctrl+I italic, ⌘/Ctrl+K link. Drop a .md file onto the window to open it.
sample:
# Welcome to the Markdown Editor

Type on the left and the preview updates as you write. Your draft is **saved automatically**.

## Features

- [x] GitHub Flavored Markdown
- [x] Outline, word count and reading time
- [ ] Export to a standalone HTML file

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| ⌘/Ctrl + S | Save |
| ⌘/Ctrl + B | Bold |

> [!TIP]
> Click a heading in the outline to jump to it.

    println!("Hello, ToolForge!");
}
